info.name: CYCLES_LIGHTGROUPS
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: lightgroup AOVs. Lights (and emissive surfaces) tagged with a 'lightGroup' name route their contribution to the beauty image into a per-lightgroup combined pass, exposed as FRAME channels named 'channel.lightgroup.<name>' (set the channel parameter to ANARI_FLOAT32_VEC3 to enable; map returns RGB float pixels holding that group's direct+indirect contribution). An HDRI light's 'lightGroup' also captures the environment's contribution. Lightgroup channels are excluded from 'denoise' (Cycles lightgroup passes cannot be denoised). Untagged emitters contribute to no lightgroup channel; the sum of all lightgroup channels plus untagged emitters' contributions reconstructs 'channel.color' RGB.
